# opnsense_nginx_upstream (Data Source)

nginx upstreams (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ Upstream ▸ Upstream**, plugin `os-nginx`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the nginx upstream.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description.
- `host_port` (Number) Add this port value to the Host header. Not used by default.
- `keepalive` (Number) Activates the connections cache for upstream server and sets the max number of idle connections that are preserved in the cache of each worker process. Leave blank or set to 0 to disable. Keepalive support should be enabled at Location settings also.
- `keepalive_requests` (Number) Sets the maximum number of requests that can be served through one keepalive connection. NGINX default is 1000.
- `keepalive_timeout` (Number) Sets a timeout in seconds during which an idle keepalive connection to an upstream server will stay open. NGINX default is 75s.
- `load_balancing_algorithm` (String) Load Balancing Algorithm. One of `ip_hash`.
- `proxy_protocol` (Boolean) If you enable the proxy protocol, an upstream proxy or server will get the client IP and the server port before the real traffic is sent.
- `serverentries` (Set of String) Server Entries.
- `store` (Boolean) Store the response on the local storage.
- `tls_client_certificate` (String) Authenticate on the Server using a client certificate.
- `tls_enable` (Boolean) Use TLS (HTTPS) to connect to the server.
- `tls_name_override` (String) Force a specific hostname for the backend connection instead of passing the hostname from the downstream connection to the upstream connection.
- `tls_protocol_versions` (Set of String) TLS: Supported Versions. One of `TLSv1`, `TLSv1.1`, `TLSv1.2`, `TLSv1.3`.
- `tls_session_reuse` (Boolean) TLS: Session Reuse.
- `tls_trusted_certificate` (Set of String) TLS: Trusted Certificate.
- `tls_verify` (Boolean) Don't turn it off unless you really know what you are doing! Never do it because a random website tells you to do.
- `tls_verify_depth` (Number) Choose how many sub-CAs can be between the server certificate and a trusted CA. 1 means the certificate has to be signed directly by a CA.
- `x_forwarded_host_verbatim` (Boolean) Use Host header value from the client request ($http_host) for X-Forwarded-Host header. $host variable is used by default. Enabling this may cause incorrect behavior in case of malicious requests such as incorrect hostnames being logged or invalid redirects being performed.
